movements.name: March in place
cues: Stand tall and lift each knee to hip height.
Swing the opposite arm; don't lean back.

movements.name: Arm circles
cues: Arms straight out to the sides, palms down.
Small circles first, then bigger. Shoulders stay low.

movements.name: Hip circles
cues: Hands on hips, feet hip-width apart.
Draw a slow circle with your hips; keep your head still.

movements.name: Bodyweight good morning
cues: Hands behind your head, soft knees.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings.

movements.name: Inchworm walk-out
cues: Fold forward and put your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a plank, then walk them back. Keep the legs as straight as you can.

movements.name: Child's pose
cues: Knees wide, big toes together, sit back on your heels.
Reach your arms forward and let your forehead rest down.

movements.name: Chest opener at a wall
cues: Forearm on a wall at shoulder height.
Turn your body away slowly until you feel the front of your shoulder.

movements.name: Standing hamstring fold
cues: Feet hip-width, knees soft.
Fold from the hips and let your head hang. Don't bounce.

modify.lowerBack: Bend your knees deeply and rest your hands on your thighs.

movements.name: Slow breathing
cues: Stand or sit tall, hands on your belly.
In for four, out for six. Let your shoulders drop.

movements.name: Standard push-up
cues: Hands just wider than shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower until your chest is a fist from the floor. Don't let your hips sag.

movements.name: Knee push-up
cues: Knees down, hands under shoulders, hips in line with your back.
Lower your chest, not your face.

movements.name: Incline push-up
cues: Hands on a counter or sturdy chair, body straight.
The higher the surface, the easier it gets.

movements.name: Wide push-up
cues: Hands a hand's width wider than a normal push-up.
Elbows point out at about 45 degrees, not straight sideways.

movements.name: Decline push-up
cues: Feet up on a chair or step, hands on the floor.
Keep your core tight so your lower back doesn't arch.

movements.name: Close-grip push-up
cues: Hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers nearly touching.
Elbows brush your ribs on the way down.

movements.name: Band row
cues: Anchor the band at chest height, step back until it's tight.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades. Don't shrug.

movements.name: Towel door row
cues: Loop a towel around a closed door's handles, lean back holding both ends.
Pull your chest to the door. Check the door is shut and latched first.

movements.name: Underhand band row
cues: Same as a band row, palms up.
Lead with your elbows; finish with a squeeze.

movements.name: Pull-up
cues: Hang from the bar, hands just wider than shoulders, palms away.
Pull your chest toward the bar, then lower all the way. No swinging.

movements.name: Slow lowering pull-up
cues: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself over five slow seconds.

movements.name: Chin-up
cues: Hang from the bar, palms facing you, shoulder-width.
Lead with your chest. Lower under control.

movements.name: Table row
cues: Lie under a sturdy table, grip the edge, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the table and keep your hips up.

movements.name: Bent-knee table row
cues: Same as a table row with your knees bent and feet flat.
Drive through your heels to keep your hips level.

movements.name: Bodyweight squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit back and down; knees track over your toes, heels stay down.

movements.name: Squat to chair
cues: Stand in front of a chair, arms forward.
Tap the chair with your hips and stand back up without rocking.

movements.name: Reverse lunge
cues: Stand tall, step one foot back.
Lower until both knees are near 90 degrees. Front knee stays over the ankle.

movements.name: Split stance hold-and-dip
cues: Take a long split stance and hold onto a chair if you need to.
Small dips straight down. Keep your torso upright.

movements.name: Glute bridge
cues: On your back, knees bent, feet flat and close to your hips.
Push through your heels and lift your hips. Squeeze at the top, don't arch your back.

movements.name: Rear-foot split squat
cues: Back foot on a chair, front foot a big step forward.
Drop the back knee straight down. Most of your weight stays on the front leg.

movements.name: Superman hold
cues: Lie face down, arms reaching forward.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches. Look at the floor, not ahead.

movements.name: Wall sit
cues: Back flat on a wall, slide down until your knees are near 90 degrees.
Knees over ankles. Breathe; don't hold your breath.

movements.name: Calf raise
cues: Stand tall, hold a wall for balance.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, lower slowly.

movements.name: Pike push-up
cues: Hips high in an upside-down V, hands shoulder-width.
Lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.

movements.name: Lateral raise
cues: Stand on the band or hold weights at your sides.
Lift your arms out to shoulder height with soft elbows. No swinging.

movements.name: Curl
cues: Stand on the band or hold weights, palms forward.
Elbows stay pinned at your sides. Lower slowly.

movements.name: Chair dip
cues: Hands on the edge of a sturdy chair, legs out in front.
Bend your elbows straight back, not out. Shoulders stay away from your ears.

movements.name: Bent-knee chair dip
cues: Same as a chair dip with knees bent and feet close.
Use your legs as little as you can.

movements.name: Overhead press
cues: Stand on the band or hold weights at your shoulders.
Press straight up without arching your back. Ribs stay down.

movements.name: Hammer curl
cues: Hold the band or weights with palms facing each other.
Same as a curl, thumbs up the whole time.

movements.name: Overhead triceps extension
cues: Hold one end of the band or one weight with both hands overhead.
Lower it behind your head by bending only at the elbows.

movements.name: Plank shoulder tap
cues: High plank, feet a little wider than hips.
Tap the opposite shoulder without rocking your hips.

movements.name: Squat jump
cues: Squat down with your arms back.
Jump straight up and land softly back into the squat.

movements.name: Squat to calf raise
cues: Squat down, then stand and rise onto your toes.
Same rhythm as a jump with no landing.

movements.name: Skater hop
cues: Hop sideways from one foot to the other.
Land softly on the outside leg, back foot sweeps behind.

movements.name: Skater step
cues: Step wide to one side and sweep the other foot behind.
Stay low and keep it smooth.

movements.name: High knees
cues: Run in place, driving your knees up.
Stay on the balls of your feet and pump your arms.

movements.name: Lateral shuffle
cues: Athletic stance, knees bent.
Shuffle three steps one way, three back. Feet never cross.

movements.name: Side step
cues: Step side to side with soft knees.
Reach your arms out as you step for a bit more work.

movements.name: Split jump
cues: Start in a lunge.
Jump and switch legs in the air. Land softly with both knees bent.

movements.name: Burpee, no push-up
cues: Squat, hands down, jump your feet back to a plank.
Jump your feet in, stand and reach up. Keep your hips level in the plank.

movements.name: Step-back burpee
cues: Hands down, step one foot back at a time to a plank.
Step back in and stand tall. No jumping.

movements.name: Cat-cow
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Breathe in as your belly drops and chest lifts; breathe out as you round your back.

movements.name: Downward dog
cues: From hands and knees, lift your hips up and back.
Press the floor away. Bend your knees if your back rounds.

modify.shoulders: Hands on a chair seat instead of the floor.

movements.name: Low lunge
cues: One foot forward between your hands, back knee down.
Sink your hips forward and lift your chest.

modify.knees: Pad the back knee with a folded blanket.

movements.name: Warrior one
cues: Front knee bent over the ankle, back heel down, hips facing forward.
Reach your arms overhead without arching your lower back.

modify.lowerBack: Hands on hips instead of overhead.

movements.name: Warrior two
cues: Wide stance, front knee bent, hips open to the side.
Arms reach long both ways; your gaze goes over the front hand.

movements.name: Reverse warrior
cues: From warrior two, flip your front palm up.
Reach up and back while the front knee stays bent.

movements.name: Triangle
cues: Wide stance with straight legs, front toes forward.
Reach forward, then tip down to your shin or a block. Don't collapse your side.

movements.name: Side angle
cues: From warrior two, rest your forearm on your front thigh.
Reach the top arm over your ear in one long line.

movements.name: Chair pose
cues: Feet together, sit back as if into a chair.
Arms up, weight in your heels, knees behind your toes.

modify.knees: Sit back less deep, weight in your heels.

movements.name: Tree
cues: Stand on one leg, sole of the other foot on your calf or thigh.
Never press the foot into the knee. Hands at your chest or overhead.

movements.name: Half moon
cues: From triangle, bend the front knee and put a hand on a block ahead.
Lift the back leg level with your hip and open your chest to the side.

modify.knees: Keep a soft bend in the standing knee and use a block.

movements.name: Bridge
cues: On your back, feet flat, arms by your sides.
Lift your hips and roll your shoulders under. Keep your knees in line with your feet.

modify.lowerBack: Lift only halfway; squeeze your glutes.

movements.name: Seated forward fold
cues: Sit with legs straight out, knees soft.
Lengthen your spine first, then fold from the hips.

modify.lowerBack: Bend your knees and sit on a folded blanket.

movements.name: Figure-four stretch
cues: On your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward you until you feel the outer hip.

movements.name: Supine twist
cues: On your back, hug one knee in, then let it fall across your body.
Both shoulders stay on the floor.

movements.name: Final rest
cues: Lie on your back, arms by your sides, palms up.
Let everything go heavy. Stay still.

movements.name: Seated centering
cues: Sit cross-legged on a folded blanket, hands on knees.
Lengthen up through the crown and breathe slowly through your nose.

movements.name: Thread the needle
cues: From hands and knees, slide one arm under your chest.
Rest your shoulder and ear down; keep your hips over your knees.

movements.name: Puppy pose
cues: From hands and knees, walk your hands forward and lower your chest.
Hips stay over your knees. Let your upper back melt down.

movements.name: Sun flow, basic
cues: Reach up, fold, half lift, step back to plank, lower to the floor, cobra, downward dog, step forward, rise.
One breath per movement. Knees down whenever you need them.

modify.shoulders: Lower your knees for the plank and skip cobra; stay in sphinx.

movements.name: Sun flow, strength
cues: Chair pose, fold, plank, lower halfway, upward dog, downward dog, then a warrior one each side between rounds.
Lower slowly with elbows hugging in. Drop your knees for the lowering if your hips sag.

modify.shoulders: Knees down for the lowering, then sphinx instead of upward dog.
modify.lowerBack: Swap upward dog for a low cobra.

movements.name: Crescent lunge
cues: High lunge, back heel lifted, arms overhead.
Square your hips and draw the lower ribs in. Front knee over ankle.

modify.knees: Shorten the stance so the front knee bends less.

movements.name: Pyramid
cues: Short stance, both legs straight, hips square.
Hinge over the front leg with a long spine; hands on blocks if the floor is far.

modify.lowerBack: Hands on blocks and fold only halfway.

movements.name: Warrior three
cues: From standing, hinge forward and lift one leg behind you.
Body and back leg form one line. Hands on hips or a chair to start.

modify.lowerBack: Hands on a chair, back leg lower.

movements.name: Standing knee hold
cues: Stand tall, hug one knee into your chest.
Stand tall through the standing leg; don't lean back.

movements.name: Goddess squat
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out, sink your hips.
Knees track over your toes. Arms at cactus, shoulder blades down.

modify.knees: Bend less; stop before any pinch.

movements.name: Wide-leg forward fold
cues: Wide stance, feet parallel, hands on hips.
Fold from the hips with a long spine, hands to the floor or blocks.

modify.lowerBack: Hands on blocks; don't round all the way down.

movements.name: Boat
cues: Sit tall, lean back slightly, lift your shins parallel to the floor.
Chest stays lifted. Hold behind your thighs to make it easier.

modify.lowerBack: Keep your toes on the floor and hold behind your thighs.

movements.name: Dolphin
cues: Forearms down, hips lifted into an upside-down V.
Press your forearms down and lift away from the floor; bend your knees if you need to.

movements.name: High plank hold
cues: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Press the floor away and keep your hips level.

movements.name: Crow
cues: Squat, hands on the floor, knees against the backs of your upper arms.
Shift forward until your feet lift. Keep a block or pillow in front of your face.

modify.knees: Skip it; hold the garland squat on a block.

movements.name: Garland squat
cues: Feet wider than hips, sink into a deep squat, palms together.
Elbows press your knees open. Sit on a block if your heels lift.

modify.knees: Sit on a block and widen your feet.

movements.name: Locust
cues: Lie face down, arms by your sides.
Lift your chest, arms and legs. Neck long, gaze down.

modify.lowerBack: Lift only your chest, or do sphinx instead.

movements.name: Sphinx
cues: Lie face down, forearms under your shoulders.
Draw your chest forward and keep your lower back relaxed.

movements.name: Lizard
cues: Low lunge with both hands inside the front foot.
Keep your front knee over your ankle. Forearms down only if your hips allow.

modify.knees: Back knee down on a blanket; stay on your hands.

movements.name: Pigeon
cues: From down dog, bring one shin forward, back leg long behind you.
Keep your hips level, with a block under the front hip if it lifts. Never force the knee.

modify.knees: Do the figure-four stretch on your back instead.

movements.name: Reclined leg stretch
cues: On your back, loop a strap or towel around one foot, leg up.
Keep the other leg long and both hips down.

movements.name: Happy baby
cues: On your back, hold the outsides of your feet, knees wide.
Let your lower back rest on the floor.

movements.name: Fighting stance
cues: Feet staggered, hands up by your cheeks, chin down.
Bounce lightly on the balls of your feet.

movements.name: Jab
cues: Punch straight out with your lead hand and snap it back.
Exhale on every punch; the other hand stays guarding your face.

movements.name: Jab-cross
cues: Jab, then punch straight with your rear hand.
Pivot the rear foot and turn your hips on the cross.

movements.name: Hook
cues: Bend your elbow to 90 degrees and swing it level across.
Power comes from turning your hips and lead foot, not the arm.

movements.name: Uppercut
cues: Dip your knees slightly and drive your fist up.
Keep the punch close to your body.

movements.name: Front kick
cues: Lift your knee, then push your foot straight out.
Pull the foot back before you set it down. Hands stay up.

movements.name: Knee strike
cues: Grab an imaginary target at chest height.
Drive your knee up and pull your hands down to meet it.

movements.name: Side kick
cues: Turn sideways, lift your knee across your body.
Push your heel out to the side; lean your torso away for balance.

movements.name: Light bounce
cues: Fighting stance, hands up.
Small, easy bounces to recover between combos.

movements.name: Forearm plank
cues: Elbows under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and pull your belly button in. Don't let your hips sag.

movements.name: Knee plank
cues: Forearms down, knees down, hips in line with your back.
Same tight core as a full plank.

movements.name: Dead bug
cues: On your back, arms up, knees bent over your hips.
Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly. Keep your lower back on the floor.

movements.name: Side plank
cues: On one forearm, feet stacked, body in a straight line.
Lift your hips; don't let them drop toward the floor.

movements.name: Knee side plank
cues: Same as a side plank with your knees bent and down.
Hips forward, in line with your shoulders.

movements.name: Bird dog
cues: Hands and knees, back flat.
Reach the opposite arm and leg long. Keep your hips level as if balancing a cup on your back.

movements.name: Hollow hold
cues: On your back, press your lower back down, lift shoulders and legs.
Bend your knees to make it easier. Your lower back never lifts.

movements.name: Mountain climber
cues: High plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive your knees toward your chest one at a time. Hips stay low.

movements.name: Slow mountain climber
cues: High plank, step one knee in at a time.
Pause each step and keep your shoulders over your hands.

movements.name: Glute bridge march
cues: Hold a glute bridge at the top.
Lift one foot at a time without your hips dropping.

movements.name: Russian twist
cues: Sit leaning back slightly, knees bent, heels down.
Turn your chest side to side, not just your arms.

movements.name: Crunch
cues: On your back, knees bent, fingertips behind your ears.
Curl your shoulders up with your belly. Don't pull on your neck.

movements.name: Bicycle
cues: On your back, hands behind your head, legs lifted.
Bring the opposite elbow toward the knee as the other leg reaches long. Slow beats fast.

movements.name: Reverse crunch
cues: On your back, knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest, then lower slowly.

movements.name: Straight-leg raise
cues: On your back, legs straight, hands under your hips.
Lower your legs only as far as your lower back stays down.

movements.name: Flutter kick
cues: On your back, legs straight and a few inches up.
Small quick kicks. Press your lower back into the floor.

movements.name: Step jack
cues: Step one foot out to the side as your arms go overhead.
Step back in and switch sides. No jumping.

movements.name: Shadow boxing
cues: Fighting stance, hands up.
Easy jabs and crosses while you move your feet.

movements.name: Butt kick
cues: Jog in place, heels toward your glutes.
Stay tall and light on your feet.

movements.name: March with arm reach
cues: March in place, reaching one arm up as the opposite knee lifts.
Keep a steady rhythm.

movements.name: Standing knee drive
cues: Stagger your feet, arms reaching up.
Pull your arms down as your back knee drives up. Switch halfway.

movements.name: Easy walk
cues: Walk in place or around the room.
Let your breathing settle.

movements.name: Neck side stretch
cues: Sit or stand tall, tip your ear toward your shoulder.
Let the opposite shoulder drop. No pulling on your head.

movements.name: Doorway chest stretch
cues: Forearms on a doorframe, elbows at shoulder height.
Step one foot through until you feel the chest open.

movements.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
cues: Bring one arm across your chest.
Hold it above the elbow with the other hand. Shoulder stays down.

movements.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
cues: Kneel on one knee, other foot forward.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and shift your hips forward.

movements.name: Seated hamstring stretch
cues: Sit with one leg straight, the other foot against the inner thigh.
Fold toward the straight leg with a long back.

movements.name: Standing quad stretch
cues: Hold a wall, grab one ankle behind you.
Knees side by side, hips pressed forward.

movements.name: Calf stretch at a wall
cues: Hands on a wall, one foot back, heel down.
Lean in with the back leg straight.
